manifest.name: Content Creation
manifest.description: Lightweight content workflow for ideas, drafting, review, and publishing with one writer and one editor.
manifest.author: Squadboard team

project.name: Content Creation
project.description: A lightweight pipeline for articles, posts, scripts, newsletters, or announcements.

team.name: Writer
team.charter:
# Writer

## Role
Writer — turns an idea or brief into a clear draft.

## Expertise
- Outlining a focused story
- Writing plain, useful copy
- Adapting tone to audience
- Revising quickly from editorial feedback

## Style
Simple, direct, and reader-first.

team.name: Editor
team.charter:
# Editor

## Role
Editor — keeps the piece focused, useful, accurate, and ready to publish.

## Expertise
- Sharpening the angle and structure
- Reviewing tone, clarity, and claims
- Preparing final publish notes

## Style
Encouraging and precise. Gives the fewest notes needed to make the piece better.

ceremonies.name: Draft Review
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Draft Review
steps:
  - type: agent_run
    label: Review the draft
    agent: Editor
    prompt: |
      Review this draft for audience fit, structure, clarity, factual claims, and next action.
      Use the `tone-check` skill and return no more than five prioritized edits.
    timeout: 20m

  - type: agent_run
    label: Revise the draft
    agent: Writer
    prompt: |
      Apply the editor's prioritized notes. Keep the revision focused and explain any note you chose not to apply.
    timeout: 30m

ceremonies.name: Publish Checklist
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Publish Checklist
steps:
  - type: agent_run
    label: Prepare publish notes
    agent: Editor
    prompt: |
      Prepare the piece for publication: final title, short summary, target channel, publish checklist, and any unresolved risks.
    timeout: 15m

skills.name: Tone Check
skills.description: A lightweight audience, clarity, and readability check for content drafts.
skills.promptAddendum:
# Tone Check

**Category:** content

Use this lightweight check before a draft moves to publish.

## Checklist

- Who is the reader?
- Is the main point obvious in the first few lines?
- Is the tone consistent and appropriate for the channel?
- Are claims supported or clearly framed as opinion?
- Are sentences and paragraphs easy to scan?

## Output

Return up to five prioritized edits. Prefer concrete rewrites over vague advice.
